adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which only allows users who are both team admin and team owner. That would deny access to a user who is an admin but not an owner (or vice versa), which is likely incorrect for the intended "admin OR owner" permission. Also, the fallback `booking.eventType?.teamId ?? 0` means this branch will never grant permission for non-team bookings (teamId undefined -> 0), making the team-role path ineffective outside team events.
